<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_AnnualAudit" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/annual-audit">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_AnnualAudit" name="Annual Audit Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_AuditRoles">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AuditCoordinator" name="Audit Coordinator">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_AuditInitiated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendNotification</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_ParallelStart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_RegionalOffice" name="Regional Office">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareFinancialStatements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GatherDocuments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_PrepJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitDocuments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideClarifications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ComplianceTeam" name="Compliance Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CentralAuditTeam" name="Central Audit Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_ReviewMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewSubmission</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_Discrepancy</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RequestClarifications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_RiskSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FinancialRiskAssessment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OperationalRiskAssessment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ComplianceRiskAssessment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_RiskJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_HighRisk</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Sub_DetailedInvestigation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_RisksMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompileAuditReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_ReportMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ResubmitReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DistributeFinalReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ArchiveFinalReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_AuditClosed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AuditDirector" name="Audit Director">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewAuditReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_ApprovalDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_AuditInitiated" name="Audit process initiated">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendNotification" name="Send notification to regional office">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_ParallelStart" name="Start parallel preparation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PrepareFinancialStatements" name="Prepare financial statements">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_GatherDocuments" name="Gather necessary documents">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates" name="Check for regulatory updates affecting the audit">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_PrepJoin" name="Preparation complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitDocuments" name="Submit documents to central audit team">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_ReviewMerge" name="Documents for review">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewSubmission" name="Review submission">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_Discrepancy" name="Discrepancies found?" default="Flow_NoIssues">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Discrepancies</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoIssues</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestClarifications" name="Request clarifications from regional office">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Discrepancies</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideClarifications" name="Provide necessary clarifications">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_RiskSplit" name="Start risk assessment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoIssues</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_FinancialRiskAssessment" name="Evaluate financial risks">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_OperationalRiskAssessment" name="Evaluate operational risks">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ComplianceRiskAssessment" name="Evaluate compliance risks">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_21</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_RiskJoin" name="Risk assessment complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_21</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_22</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_HighRisk" name="High risk identified?" default="Flow_NoHighRisk">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_22</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HighRisk</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoHighRisk</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="Sub_DetailedInvestigation" name="Launch detailed investigation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HighRisk</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_25</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="SubStart_Investigation" name="Investigation launched">
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PerformDataAnalysis" name="Perform data analysis">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_01</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:userTask>
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ConductInterviews" name="Conduct interviews">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_02</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:userTask>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_SiteVisitNeeded" name="Site visit required?" default="SubFlow_NoSiteVisit">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_03</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_SiteVisit</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_NoSiteVisit</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ConductSiteVisit" name="Conduct site visit">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_SiteVisit</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:userTask>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_SiteVisitMerge" name="Investigation activities done">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_04</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_NoSiteVisit</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="SubEnd_Investigation" name="Investigation completed">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_01" sourceRef="SubStart_Investigation" targetRef="Task_PerformDataAnalysis"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_02" sourceRef="Task_PerformDataAnalysis" targetRef="Task_ConductInterviews"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_03" sourceRef="Task_ConductInterviews" targetRef="Gw_SiteVisitNeeded"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_SiteVisit" name="Site visit needed" sourceRef="Gw_SiteVisitNeeded" targetRef="Task_ConductSiteVisit"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_NoSiteVisit" name="No site visit" sourceRef="Gw_SiteVisitNeeded" targetRef="Gw_SiteVisitMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_04" sourceRef="Task_ConductSiteVisit" targetRef="Gw_SiteVisitMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_05" sourceRef="Gw_SiteVisitMerge" targetRef="SubEnd_Investigation"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_RisksMerge" name="All risks addressed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_25</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoHighRisk</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_26</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompileAuditReport" name="Compile audit report">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_26</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_27</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_ReportMerge" name="Report ready for director review">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_27</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_33</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_28</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewAuditReport" name="Review audit report">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_28</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_29</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_ApprovalDecision" name="Report approved?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_29</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_30</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_31</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateReport" name="Update report with revisions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_31</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_32</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ResubmitReport" name="Resubmit report for review">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_32</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_33</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DistributeFinalReport" name="Distribute final report to executive board">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_30</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_34</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ArchiveFinalReport" name="Archive final report">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_34</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_35</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_AuditClosed" name="Audit process closed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_35</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_AuditInitiated" targetRef="Task_SendNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_SendNotification" targetRef="Gw_ParallelStart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Gw_ParallelStart" targetRef="Task_PrepareFinancialStatements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gw_ParallelStart" targetRef="Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFinancialStatements" targetRef="Task_GatherDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_GatherDocuments" targetRef="Gw_PrepJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates" targetRef="Gw_PrepJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gw_PrepJoin" targetRef="Task_SubmitDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_SubmitDocuments" targetRef="Gw_ReviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gw_ReviewMerge" targetRef="Task_ReviewSubmission"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_ReviewSubmission" targetRef="Gw_Discrepancy"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Discrepancies" name="Discrepancies found" sourceRef="Gw_Discrepancy" targetRef="Task_RequestClarifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoIssues" name="No issues" sourceRef="Gw_Discrepancy" targetRef="Gw_RiskSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_RequestClarifications" targetRef="Task_ProvideClarifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_ProvideClarifications" targetRef="Gw_ReviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gw_RiskSplit" targetRef="Task_FinancialRiskAssessment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Gw_RiskSplit" targetRef="Task_OperationalRiskAssessment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gw_RiskSplit" targetRef="Task_ComplianceRiskAssessment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_FinancialRiskAssessment" targetRef="Gw_RiskJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_OperationalRiskAssessment" targetRef="Gw_RiskJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_ComplianceRiskAssessment" targetRef="Gw_RiskJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Gw_RiskJoin" targetRef="Gw_HighRisk"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HighRisk" name="High risk identified" sourceRef="Gw_HighRisk" targetRef="Sub_DetailedInvestigation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoHighRisk" name="No high risk" sourceRef="Gw_HighRisk" targetRef="Gw_RisksMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Sub_DetailedInvestigation" targetRef="Gw_RisksMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Gw_RisksMerge" targetRef="Task_CompileAuditReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="Task_CompileAuditReport" targetRef="Gw_ReportMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_28" sourceRef="Gw_ReportMerge" targetRef="Task_ReviewAuditReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_29" sourceRef="Task_ReviewAuditReport" targetRef="Gw_ApprovalDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_30" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gw_ApprovalDecision" targetRef="Task_DistributeFinalReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_31" name="Revisions required" sourceRef="Gw_ApprovalDecision" targetRef="Task_UpdateReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_32" sourceRef="Task_UpdateReport" targetRef="Task_ResubmitReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_33" sourceRef="Task_ResubmitReport" targetRef="Gw_ReportMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_34" sourceRef="Task_DistributeFinalReport" targetRef="Task_ArchiveFinalReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_35" sourceRef="Task_ArchiveFinalReport" targetRef="EndEvent_AuditClosed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
